addressExtension.description: Address extension (e.g. XRP tag, EOS memo). Required for networks where `needAddressExtension` is `true` in the [Crypto Networks](../query-crypto-networks) response

amountIncludeFee.description: Whether the fee is included in the amount or not. The default value is set to `true`.

webhookUrl.description: If you wish to receive notifications, please fill in the 'webhookUrl' parameter. Also, kindly notify us so that we can add the 'webhookUrl' to the whitelist.
